environment: Linux Chromium headless via Playwright. Most suites load the HTML with page.set_content; the HEIC suite opens index.html and vendor/heic-decoder.html from a local folder (file://) and from a local web server.
limitations: No verification of the user Windows installation.
Native Windows file drag, the OS save dialog and GitHub Pages deployment were not tested end-to-end; file:// navigation is exercised only by the HEIC suite.
The bundled HEIC decoder and its sandbox were run in Chromium only; Firefox, Safari (including its native HEIC decoding), phones and tablets were not tested.
Browser localStorage denied-path was tested; persistent cross-session storage not tested end-to-end.
No AI background removal, AI upscaling or HTML capture is included.
